name: Noob Exterminators
desc:
[⚠️WARNING⚠️]
THIS GAME HAS HORROR ELEMENTS AND JUMPSCARES

Welcome fellow Exterminator, this is a chaotic game where you're the last line of defense between peaceful homes and an infestation of noobs. Your job is to respond customer mails, travel to their homes and "clear" them. This game is hard to play alone, and it's more fun with friends!

Available on:
💻- PC
📱- Mobile Devices
🎮- Consoles

(Inspired by Lethal Company, by Zeekerss)
